name: Can existing bathroom cabinetry be refinished or refaced, or is replacement always necessary?

mainEntity.name: Can existing bathroom cabinetry be refinished or refaced, or is replacement always necessary?

acceptedAnswer.text: Whether to refinish, reface, or replace bathroom cabinetry depends on its current condition, structural integrity, and your desired outcome. Refinishing can update the look of solid wood cabinets if the structure is sound, while refacing replaces doors and drawer fronts for a fresh appearance. However, if the cabinetry is dated in layout, lacks functionality, or has structural issues, a full replacement with custom cabinetry is often the best approach for a luxury bathroom renovation. We assess your existing setup to recommend the most effective solution for enhancing functionality, beauty, and value.
acceptedAnswer.description: Refinishing or refacing existing cabinetry is possible if the structure is sound. For significant layout, functionality, or structural issues, full replacement with custom cabinetry is often recommended to enhance your bathroom.
